draft.full_post:
Imagine walking out of a chaotic 45-minute brainstorming session and realizing you forgot to write down the three most critical action items. Your Apple Watch just pinged you with a perfect summary of exactly who promised what.

Apple has officially begun beta testing AI-powered conversation recaps for the Apple Watch, and it’s a game-changer for the wearable market.

⚡ 𝗧𝗵𝗲 𝗕𝗿𝗲𝗮𝗸𝘁𝗵𝗿𝗼𝘂𝗴𝗵: On-device AI now lets you "rewind" and recap live conversations directly from your wrist.

📌 𝗧𝗵𝗲 𝗘𝗱𝗴𝗲: Apple is processing this audio locally to maintain privacy while delivering instant meeting notes.

🔍 𝗧𝗵𝗲 𝗗𝗲𝗯𝗮𝘁𝗲: This turns every casual chat into a searchable record, blurring the lines of workplace consent.

💬 Is having a "searchable memory" on your wrist the ultimate productivity hack, or is this the end of private office talk?
